newsitem.title: USA: Employee Solutions sees Q4 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Employee Solutions sees Q4 below estimates.

text.p: Employee Solutions Inc said Friday it expects to report fourth-quarter earnings below analysts' estimates but will report a profit for both the quarter and full year.
The company provided no specific figures, and company officials were not available for comment.
Employee Solutions said it intends to report its results for the year and fourth quarter "as soon as practicable" but is unable at this time to estimate when that will be.
Employee Solutions's stock lost about half its market value Thursday, or more than $300 million, amid worries about lower earnings.
The shares closed at 15-3/8, down 4-1/2, then fell to 10 in after-hours trading after the company announced it was delaying release of its fourth quarter results.
